heur._doc: rule accuracy = share of images whose rule-chosen front shape is the true front shape (0.5 credit if the rule is undefined). Rules answer by relation, not by phrasing, so accuracy is identical under both object orders / both phrasings of the same image. size_visible: larger visible area is in front; size_drawn: larger drawn (unoccluded) area; lower: lower in the image is closer. Synthetic Depth geometry: syn_depth_geometry.json (px = visible pixels, cy = vertical centre); twins: e2d meta; cue set: e10 *_cues meta; hard set: e2h meta.

comp.rule: occlusion-competent := (i) Direct accuracy on the size- and vertical-balanced cue-factorial set has 95% CI lower bound > 70% AND (ii) the Direct probit-GLM occlusion weight on that set has CI lower bound > 0. Models without a cue-set run (Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking) are 'not evaluable' under the rule. Secondary, reported only: Direct twin pair-matched d' CI lower bound > 1 and twin accuracy CI lower bound > 70%.

protocol.direct_prompt: user turn: question + options + "Answer with the option's letter only."; answer parsed from the returned text
protocol.cot_prompt: user turn: question + options + "Let's think step by step: first describe what you see that matters for the question, then reason, and end with 'Answer: (X)' where X is the option letter."; answer parsed from 'Answer: (X)' in the returned text
protocol.open_model_cot: open models: CoT is an assistant-turn prefix 'Let's think step by step.' continued greedily (<= 512 tokens), answer read as the forced next-token distribution after 'Answer: (' (same turn); Direct = forced readout right after the question
protocol.effort_mechanism: api_client.chat sends reasoning_effort=<effort> (Gemini since 2026-11-13: thinking_config.thinking_level); temperature not set (provider default); max_completion_tokens 16,384 (Direct/CoT) or 512 (direct_nr)
protocol.e9x_default_effort: e9x_api.py --effort default 'high' for both Direct and CoT; research_log Exp-9x: 'effort=high'; records written before the 'effort' field was added carry None
protocol.direct_nr: only Direct was re-run without reasoning ('direct_nr': none for DeepSeek / Qwen3.8-Max; Claude 'minimal'; GPT 'low'); no CoT arm at reasoning none/low exists except DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on the cue set (both arms 'none')

proposal.title: Seeing Right, Writing Wrong: Where Short Chain-of-Thought Breaks Spatial VQA (verbatim)
proposal.scope_sentence: 'Seeing right' is claimed only for models that pass the pre-stated occlusion-competence rule (Molmo-7B-D, Qwen3-VL-8B); Synthetic Depth is a size-confounded stress test (size rule 98.6%), not evidence of occlusion reading.

claims.claim: In occlusion-competent models, writing a rationale weakens the answer's dependence on occlusion on a set where size and vertical position are balanced.
claims.primary_estimator: cue-factorial probit-GLM occlusion weight, CoT - Direct (d' units, twin-pair bootstrap)
claims.secondary: cue accuracy Molmo -13.1 [-15.3, -10.8], Qwen3-VL-8B -1.6 [-4.4, +1.1] (vertical prior flips 1.49 -> -0.64, offsetting); twins d'_pair -0.88 [-1.66, -0.33] / +0.02 [-0.54, +0.74]; Synthetic Depth 431 d'_pair -0.78 / -1.55; caveat: other cue weights shrink too (not occlusion-selective)

claims.claim: The loss enters at a written relational claim that contradicts the image, and the answer follows that claim.
claims.primary_estimator: two-judge consensus contradiction rate of commit sentences j* (D+C-) vs position-matched relational D+C+ sentences, pooled over the competent models
claims.values: 50/58 = 86.2% [75.1, 92.8] vs 6/62 = 9.7% [4.5, 19.5]; 38/46 = 82.6% on images Direct answers correctly under both object orders (all seven models: 208/235 = 88.5% vs 22/226 = 9.7%; 431 overlapping items: 184/209 = 88.0% vs 19/203 = 9.4%)
claims.secondary: claim edits (same-turn regeneration): D+C- correct claim Qwen3-VL-8B 97.8% vs neutral 30.1% (twins 100.0 vs 23.5), Molmo 68.6 vs 56.0 (twins 64.2 vs 60.5, n.s.); D+C+ wrong claim 6.6% / 18.6% vs neutral 91.1 / 81.9; human check n=9 D+C- 6/9 (Exp-24) as a caveat; copier/checker answer-step taxonomy
claims.source: commit_judge.json, syn_pair_sdt.json seeing, claim_edit.json, e27_reframe.json comp.pooled_audit / ovl.commit_audit

claims.claim: Elsewhere the effect is not a corrupted readout: in shortcut-reliant models Direct mostly follows 'lower is closer' and CoT dilutes that prior (accuracy flat or up on balanced sets), and on natural images the CoT-Direct effect is small and benchmark-specific.
claims.primary_estimator: pre-registered held-out pool (767 BLINK + 3DSRBench items) CoT - Direct accuracy per model
claims.values: -3.1 to +1.3 points; no per-model 95% CI excludes zero (Qwen2.5-VL-7B -3.1 [-6.4, +0.3]; Gemini-Argon review's 'significant in Qwen2.5-VL-7B' is not supported) (e6_eval.json pooled, Tab. 2B)
claims.secondary: cue set Direct agreement with lower-is-closer 84.9-96.2% in Qwen2.5-VL-3B/7B, InternVL3-8B, InternVL3.5-8B (CoT 58.6-81.6%), cue accuracy +0.6 to +4.8; BLINK Relative Depth vs Filler+turn CI<0 in 1/7; 3DSRBench depth flat, height/above/left improve; depth-valid 324: 0/7 CI<0 (post hoc)

proposal.move_to_supp: gate, AFE, symmetrization, vote prediction, structured state, steering, scale ladder details, closed-model table (with the reasoning-effort disclosure)
proposal.closed_model_disclosure: Closed models were queried once per item through an API with reasoning_effort=high in both arms (hidden reasoning present in both), CoT requested in the user turn and the answer parsed from text; only Direct was also run with reasoning off or at the lowest level, so the closed-model contrast is visible-plus-hidden versus hidden reasoning, not CoT versus a reasoning-free readout.
proposal.readout_disclosure: All open-model runs decode greedily (T = 0, seed 0) with vLLM; batch composition and engine version change floating-point reductions, so a rationale regenerated in a later run can differ from the stored one: Tab. 1 re-reads the original rationales, while the state, probe, gate and answer-first experiments regenerate them, which moves Synthetic Depth CoT accuracy by up to 3.6 points (Direct answers are unchanged); the D+/-C+/- cells of Sec. 5 use the original runs' top-20 readout and differ from Tab. 1 on 22-83 near-tie items in the four exact-readout models.
